purpose: Reduce Framework v1's runaway reporting from 11 files/session (peak 29) to 4 standardized files per session. Every report must serve a specific downstream governance purpose — no 'report about reports.' Eliminates the 65% non-consumption rate and 3.5:1 metric duplication ratio.

motivation.v1_crisis: 1,227 files across 178 sessions. 843 JSON + 372 MD. 65% never consumed by any downstream governance process. 7 files per session redundantly report certified count. 5 files report Domain E count. 6 files report EW integrity metrics. Core 15 metrics spread across 5.3 files each. S809 chain: 47 report files for items with 0 writes. Reporting overhead is itself a defect — it consumes agent time, clutters the file system, and makes it harder to find what matters.
motivation.target: 4 files per session. Standardized naming (SESSIONXXX_ prefix). All metrics in one dashboard. All decisions in one summary. All quality results in one verdict. All certification results in one record.

report_files.role: Single source of truth for all portfolio-level metrics

certified_pool.certified_this_session: Integer — items newly certified in this session

defect_status.by_defect_class: Object — defect class → count (auto-generated from scan artifact)

learner_pool_risk.certified_defective: Integer — Certified items with open HIGH+ defects

readiness.items_by_state: Object — state → count (BLOCKED, REMEDIATE, READY, CERTIFY)
readiness.scan_pass_rate: Float — from scan artifact aggregate statistics

portfolio_health.health_index: Float (0-100) — composite score from defect density + certification coverage + readiness

report_files.role: Executive narrative of everything that happened in the session
report_files.replaces: Multiple per-agent session summaries + meta-reporting packages

sections: 1. Session Overview — session ID, date, mode (read-only vs. execution), purpose, scope (what was in/out)
2. Pre-Flight Results — scan pipeline summary, items scanned/passed/blocked, key defect findings
3. Board Decisions — per-board: items processed, decisions rendered (CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE), consensus status
4. Certification Actions — items certified this session, before/after counts, batch size verification
5. Defects Discovered — any new defects found during review, logged to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md status
6. Open Items — what was NOT completed, deferred decisions, next-session preconditions
7. Session Closeout — Tend hash verification, backup protocol status, governance attestation, REVISION_HISTORY.md entry logged
8. Readiness Board Verdict — READY or BLOCKED for next session, with blocker list if BLOCKED

report_files.role: Per-item quality assessment with 10-dimension CAQS rubric scores

content.consensus_model: ALL_AGREE (≥2 of 3 must agree on CERTIFIABLE)
content.items_reviewed: Integer — only items routed for review (content_change, metadata_change, new items)

caqs_scores.agent_3_scores: Object — dimensions 9, 10 scores + structural compliance + comments

verdicts.hold_reason: String — if HOLD, which dimension(s) and what resolution is needed
verdicts.recommendation: String — free-text recommendation from Quality Board to Certification Board

report_files.role: Final per-item certification decisions + REVISION_HISTORY.md entry data
report_files.replaces: Scattered certification record files + REVISION_HISTORY.md draft entries

certification_actions.quality_verdict_ref: String — reference to Quality Verdict item entry
certification_actions.distractor_tier_map: Object — {A: tier_label, B: tier_label, C: tier_label, D: tier_label}

revision_history_batch.description: Complete REVISION_HISTORY.md entry for this session — ready to append
revision_history_batch.entry_text: String — markdown formatted entry covering all certification actions

legacy_report_archive_plan.description: Existing 1,227 legacy report files are not deleted. They are archived for historical reference.
legacy_report_archive_plan.index: reports/archive/v1/REPORT_INDEX.json — maps session ID → list of legacy report files with descriptions
legacy_report_archive_plan.retention: Indefinite — zero cost to retain. Legacy reports may be re-consumed during Framework v2 Phase 2 validation (dual-run comparison against Quality Board verdicts).

naming_standard.prefix: SESSION{N}_ — where N is the 3-digit session number (e.g., SESSION321_, SESSION322_)
naming_standard.format: Dash-separated snake_case for multi-word names within the filename body

enforcement.soft_cap: 8 files per session (per S201 D-05, approved decision). Exceeding 8 requires BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker.
enforcement.target: 4 files per regular session (DASHBOARD + SESSION_SUMMARY + QUALITY_VERDICT + CERTIFICATION_RESULTS).
enforcement.exception: Sessions with specialized board activities may produce up to 2 additional domain-specific report files (total ≤ 6). These must be justified in the SESSION_SUMMARY.md.
enforcement.governance_guard_integration: Governance guard Rule 5 (30-item cap) can be extended with a reporting cap rule in Phase 3 if the 8-file soft cap is insufficient.

success_criteria.SC-BH-01: 4 report files per session: DASHBOARD.json, SESSION_SUMMARY.md, QUALITY_VERDICT.json, CERTIFICATION_RESULTS.json.
success_criteria.SC-BH-02: DASHBOARD.json replaces all redundant dashboard variants — single source of truth for portfolio metrics.
success_criteria.SC-BH-03: SESSION_SUMMARY.md standardizes the 8-section executive narrative format.
success_criteria.SC-BH-04: QUALITY_VERDICT.json embeds all 3 Quality Board agent outputs (replaces 120+ individual agent output files).
success_criteria.SC-BH-05: CERTIFICATION_RESULTS.json pre-formats REVISION_HISTORY.md entries (eliminates hand-written entries).
success_criteria.SC-BH-06: Naming standard: SESSION{N}_ prefix, no legacy agent/board naming variants.
success_criteria.SC-BH-07: Soft cap of 8 files with BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker; target of 4 with 2 additional domain-specific exceptions.
success_criteria.SC-BH-08: Legacy report archive plan defined — 1,227 files indexed and preserved, not deleted.
success_criteria.SC-BH-09: Every report serves a specific downstream governance purpose — no 'reports about reports.'
success_criteria.SC-BH-10: Specification is implementable — S322 can begin using these report formats.
success_criteria.SC-BH-11: 0 certification actions, 0 content modifications, 0 pack-file writes.
